name: mimicry
description: Reconstruct visual templates as native, editable Office and Google Workspace artifacts.

interface.longDescription: Recreates screenshots, PDFs, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and Google Workspace templates as native editable artifacts, including LTR, RTL, and mixed-direction layouts.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $mimicry to recreate this template as an editable artifact while preserving its design.
